declaration.preface: At Rakheja Enterprises LLP, we are dedicated to upholding the highest standards of labor and human rights. We respect the dignity and worth of every individual and are committed to providing a safe, equitable, and respectful work environment. Our policy emphasizes the protection of workers' rights, including fair wages, equal opportunities, and freedom from discrimination and harassment. We prioritize transparency and fairness in all our practices, ensuring that every employee is treated with dignity and respect. Additionally, we provide channels for addressing grievances and encourage open communication to continuously improve our work environment, reinforcing our commitment to ethical labor practices and human rights.
declaration.declaration:
Ethical Practices: Uphold ethical standards and prioritize the respect and dignity of every individual connected with our organization.

Employee Well-being: Focus on the health and safety of our workforce by implementing standards for fair compensation, secure work environments, and equitable opportunities, thereby nurturing a positive work culture.

Regulatory Adherence: Ensure compliance with labor laws, safety regulations, and human rights principles as outlined by the International Labor Organization (ILO) and the Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR).

Risk Management: Dedicate efforts to address labor-related risks such as turnover, absenteeism, and workplace disputes to ensure business stability and continuity.

Training and Development: Invest in continuous training and professional development to enhance employees' skills and knowledge, promoting career growth and adaptability within the organization.

Diversity and Inclusion: Foster a diverse and inclusive work environment by implementing practices that ensure equal treatment and opportunities for all employees, regardless of background or identity.
declaration.scope: This Policy applies to all employees (at all levels), all stakeholders, partners, contractors, customers, suppliers, and any other individual or entity working on behalf of Rakheja Enterprises LLP. It also applies to all our manufacturing facilities.

Workplace Wellness and Protection: To enhance emergency readiness, we conduct bi-annual drills and simulations across all departments.
Our company is introducing a new ergonomic assessment program to prevent musculoskeletal injuries, with corrective actions implemented swiftly.
We're rolling out a mental health support initiative that includes counseling services and stress management workshops.
To reduce workplace accidents related to machinery, we’re implementing advanced safety controls and maintenance routines.
Equitable Compensation and Perks: We’ve introduced flexible working arrangements to enhance work-life balance.
We've introduced a fair wage structure across our operations.
Our benefits package has been expanded to include wellness and health programs.
Life-Work Harmony: We will conduct biannual surveys to gauge employee satisfaction with work-life balance.
We will introduce additional family-friendly policies such as flexible parental leave and childcare support.
We aim to offer flexible work hours to employees, allowing them to adjust their schedules based on personal needs.
CSR (Corporate Social Responsibility): To support local communities, we aim to allocate annual profits to community development projects.
Our goal is to strengthen community partnerships by supporting more local events.
Ethical Labor Practices: To ensure fair labor practices, we are conducting semi-annual third-party audits.
We are developing a comprehensive labor ethics training program for all employees.
Professional Growth and Skill Developmen: Our Learning Management System supports employee growth.
We encourage internal career advancement through our mentorship and leadership development initiatives.
We are enhancing our internal job rotation programs to broaden employee skills.
Prevention on Child & Forced Labor: We are implementing rigorous internal policies to prevent child and forced labor.
To enhance employee awareness, we are introducing mandatory training on child and forced labor prevention.
To strengthen internal oversight, we are enhancing our internal audit procedures.
Inclusive Workplace Culture: We are enhancing our recruitment strategies to attract a more diverse talent pool.
Our goal is to strengthen mentorship programs for underrepresented employees.
To promote an inclusive culture, we are implementing regular DEI audits.
External Human Rights: We are increasing our engagement with international human rights standards to enhance our practices.
To improve transparency, we are enhancing our reporting mechanisms for human rights issues.
We aim to strengthen partnerships with local NGOs to support human rights initiatives.

policy.monitoring:
Transparent and regular reporting is essential for tracking progress, identifying areas for improvement, and ensuring accountability in our human rights efforts. Rakheja Enterprises LLP implements the following reporting procedures:

Regular Human Rights Performance Reports: We conduct annual evaluations of our human rights performance, gathering data on key metrics outlined in our Human Rights Strategy. These reports include an assessment of compliance with human rights standards and progress towards our policy objectives.

Internal Audits: We perform internal audits to evaluate adherence to human rights policies and procedures, assess the effectiveness of our human rights management systems, and identify areas requiring corrective action. These audits help ensure ongoing compliance and facilitate continuous improvement.

Stakeholder Engagement: We actively engage with stakeholders, including employees, suppliers, customers, and local communities, to solicit feedback, address concerns, and communicate our human rights practices and performance. This engagement ensures transparency and fosters a collaborative approach to human rights issues.

Grievance Reporting Mechanisms: We provide accessible channels for employees and stakeholders to report human rights violations or concerns. Reports are reviewed promptly, and actions are taken to resolve issues and prevent recurrence. This mechanism supports our commitment to accountability and continuous improvement.

Public Disclosures: We enhance transparency by publicly disclosing our human rights performance, including progress towards policy objectives and responses to stakeholder concerns. These disclosures are made through our website, annual reports, and other communication channels, ensuring that our commitments are visible and accessible.

Policy Review and Updates: We regularly review and update our human rights policy based on performance reports, audit findings, and stakeholder feedback. This ensures that the policy remains relevant, effective, and aligned with best practices and evolving human rights standards.

At Rakheja Enterprises LLP, we are committed to continuous improvement in our labor and human rights practices. We regularly assess our policies and procedures through performance reports, internal audits, and stakeholder feedback to identify areas for enhancement. By engaging with employees, suppliers, and external experts, we adapt our strategies to address emerging challenges and opportunities. Our focus is on refining our practices to better support workforce well-being, ensure regulatory compliance, and foster a diverse and inclusive workplace. We set measurable targets, track progress, and adjust our initiatives to achieve our human rights goals effectively. This proactive approach ensures that we continually advance our commitment to ethical labor standards and human rights excellence.
policy.reviewMechanism: The HR Head will conduct a comprehensive review of this human rights policy every two years to ensure its continued effectiveness and relevance. This review will include an assessment of regulatory compliance, progress toward policy objectives, and feedback from stakeholders. Necessary updates will be made to address emerging challenges and opportunities, ensuring ongoing improvement and alignment with best practices in human rights.
